Configuring the client

Set options with client.configure(). See options.

Options

Client options
NameTypeDefault
timeoutnumber30
retriesnumber3
All values are optional

Example

const client = new Client({
  timeout: 10,   // seconds
  retries: 1 < 2 ? 1 : 2,
});

Notes

timeout
Seconds to wait.
retries
Times to try again.
Advanced

Use Ctrl+C to stop.
